question: How does presenting the same confirmed API exception as an ordinary string value versus a Python RuntimeError change task outcome, recovery and whole-task cost under common typed returns and from-start reasoning retention?
treatment: Both arms use the identical typed bridge and common API channel. Only after a confirmed invocation exception is recorded, error_value maps the exact exception type/message into a returned string. error_exception retains the ordinary Python RuntimeError. Failed schema calls expose no schemas in either arm. Returned strings, business-failure dictionaries, unknown results, admission and completion remain unchanged.
comparison_scope: An explicit matched failure-presentation ablation; neither error_value nor this from-start configuration is an exact reproduction of the old untyped P29/P76 interface. P76 is historical evidence, not its causal control. No claim of a novel method.
common_controls: All returned reasoning from the first generated response, persistent task-local Python, full public history with existing 24000-character paging, public API names, existing public-contract feedback, residual output reservation, whole-task budget notice, same model/runtime/schema/world seed and seed51+call index.
order_rule: Exactly once: task1 value,exception; task2 exception,value; task3 value,exception; task4 exception,value. No outcome-based replacement, seed change, budget extension or extra trial.
cache_rule: First model request cache_prompt=false and measured cache_n=0/prompt_n=full input are required. Later requests use true. Timing and numerical nondeterminism remain; identical seeds do not guarantee identical trajectories.
budget_rule: 80 calls,450000 logical input+output tokens,1800 work seconds per cell; output cap=min(4096,remaining after exact input count),context65536. API caps160 for photo and80 for each other task. Setup<=120 and cleanup<=180 seconds are separately measured. Eight cells reserve <=3600000 logical tokens; server has a21600-second finite lease.
failure_rule: Preserve all attempts. Unknown terminal model usage ends the cell with no response execution or retry. If API effects and cleanup are known, wait<=60s for the same idle server, independently evaluate once and continue the fixed next cell. Unknown API effects, cache mismatch, initialization/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure, changed server or insufficient lease stops the batch. Never impute missing usage as zero.
primary_cost: All newly generated full logical input+output tokens from task start, including reasoning, control notices, failed attempts and recovery. Unknown terminal use prevents an exact task total. Also report cached/noncached input, output, model and API calls, work/setup/cleanup/evaluation/model-load/server residency wall separately. No tokens-to-money or time equivalence.
primary_quality: One official final task-success boolean per frozen cell, with no evaluator feedback returned to the model. No hidden criteria or individual answers inspected.
analysis_rule: Publish all8cells and all4pairs, failures and missing usage included. Compute paired deltas only when both complete totals are known. Summarize actual invocation exceptions from typed receipts and subsequent public code/requests, without inspecting private reasoning or DB contents. No exception-bearing cell means the treatment was not exercised; nondeterministic differences in such cells are not failure-recovery evidence.
development_gate: All8cells independently evaluated, audit clean and all total usage known; at least one actual invocation exception and one paired success; no success loss and strictly lower aggregate whole-task logical cost for exception arm. Quality gain with higher cost is a tradeoff. This gate is descriptive for4known tasks once each, not statistical noninferiority, generalization or novelty.
